bark: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production BASE COLOR bark texture atlas for low-poly woodland trees, not a tree illustration. Create ONE square texture atlas, exactly 2 columns by 2 rows, four equal square tiles touching with no gutters, labels, borders or text. Top left: pine/spruce bark, desaturated warm brown with long chunky vertical fissures and small grey-brown plate clusters. Top right: birch bark, warm off-white and light grey with irregular short black/dark charcoal horizontal lenticels, occasional tan scars, believable sparse markings. Bottom left: oak/maple bark, grey-brown deeply furrowed angular vertical ridges, muted earth shadows. Bottom right: willow/poplar bark, muted olive grey brown with finer vertical interrupted grooves. Deliberate hand-painted PIXEL ART texture: each tile should visually use a 64 by 64 pixel grid enlarged cleanly, chunky connected pixel clusters, about 8-12 shades per tile, no anti-aliasing, no blurry gradients, no photographic noise. Flat unlit albedo: no baked directional lighting or highlights, no cast shadows. Patterns fill each tile edge-to-edge and should tile plausibly vertically and horizontally. Natural quiet woodland palette, not saturated orange bark. This is a material texture sheet only, no objects or perspective.
foliage: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: ONE production pixel-art woodland foliage BASE COLOR material atlas. Make a wide image exactly 4 columns by 2 rows, 8 equal square texture tiles, absolutely NO borders, gutters, labels or text. Top row left to right: 1 dark muted olive-green pine needle sprays; 2 cooler deep blue-green spruce needle sprays; 3 fresh subdued yellow-green birch leaf clusters; 4 ochre/gold autumn birch leaf clusters. Bottom row left to right: 5 broad oak leaf clusters in medium natural moss/olive greens; 6 autumn maple foliage in muted burnt orange/copper/russet reds, avoid bright scarlet; 7 sparse woodland leaves in desaturated grey sage greens; 8 willow leaves in muted olive green with long hanging leaf dashes. Each tile is a dense contiguous foliage surface texture: chunky overlapping pixel clusters shaped like small leaf groups or needle sprays, approximately 64x64 logical pixels per tile, enlarged sharp square pixels, 6-10 deliberate shades per tile. NO individual giant leaves, NO complete trees or branches, NO photorealistic noise. Fill the entire tile edge to edge, no transparent background. Varied darker crevices and midtones, few subdued highlights. These textures will be mapped onto low-poly 3D crowns and clipped leaf-card borders; make the mottled clusters readable from elevated game camera distance. Flat unlit albedo, no baked directional lighting, no gradients, no blur, no anti-aliasing, no 3D perspective. Natural restrained colors matching a grounded stylized woodland survival RPG.
cutouts: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: transparent pixel-art foliage branch-card atlas for a real-time 3D woodland asset pack. ONE square image with four equal square quadrants (2x2); each quadrant is a SEPARATE isolated cutout, entirely inside its own tile with a little transparent space on all four edges. No borders, no labels, no text. TOP LEFT: an irregular broadleaf twig spray, little brown twig branching from bottom middle through dense clusters of small olive-green birch/oak leaves, many natural transparent notches and small gaps, broad oval asymmetrical outline. TOP RIGHT: a triangular pine/spruce needle branch spray extending from bottom middle to several tapered ends, dark muted conifer greens, layered short needle clusters, jagged irregular edges and gaps, not a whole tree. BOTTOM LEFT: a hanging willow foliage curtain: several skinny curved twigs originating along the TOP of the tile, hanging downward with narrow drooping olive-green leaves, uneven bottom ends and vertical transparent gaps, no bottom stem. BOTTOM RIGHT: a sparse crooked twig with small separated grey-sage leaf groups, generous transparent gaps, branch starts at bottom center. All four have chunky visibly square 64x64 logical pixel treatment, enlarged with nearest neighbor, no smoothing or anti-aliasing, no blur, no photographic detail. Original game sprites intended as texture maps applied to polygon foliage cards. Natural low saturation palette, several deliberate shades, flat albedo/no cast shadows or lighting gradients. Genuine transparent background, not white, not checkerboard. Keep alpha edges binary and crisp. The primary reference look is low-poly realistic woodland with strong pixel-art textures, not cartoons.
